objective: Measure zero-shot text quality for matched Qwen3-VL Base, Full AttnRes, and Full RSM-AttnRes checkpoints at 2B and 4B scale.

excluded.rsm_reskip: The frozen safe policy is decode_only, while stock lm-eval loglikelihood uses full-sequence forwards without cached one-token decoding. Including it would not exercise ReSkip.
excluded.gsm8k: Generative accuracy would introduce answer-extraction and chat-template choices into an otherwise deterministic loglikelihood panel.
excluded.mmlu: Omitted from the compact panel to avoid a 57-subject five-shot aggregate and keep every selected column under one zero-shot protocol.
